Minbox text archive

Privacy policy

Last updated October 13, 2026. This describes owner-managed Android/Linux installations and the fixture-tested Mac/iPhone adapter. Live Mac/iPhone acceptance remains unverified.

What the application handles

Minbox processes accessible message text, sender/recipient identifiers, conversation identifiers, timestamps, revisions and attachment metadata and available original images, with optional local OCR. It may capture accessible transcripts from Loom links in those messages. Restricted videos and unavailable message formats remain reported gaps.

Where information is stored

Archives, settings and Google credentials stay on the owner’s collection computer: Linux for Android, or Mac for iPhone. The administrator of that computer can access its local data. Private archive copies are stored in the owner's Google Drive.

Local file permissions restrict access; they are not a guarantee of encryption at rest. Device encryption and independent backups require separate setup. Source code updates do not contain archives or account credentials.

Google account permissions

For new connections, you create a private Drive folder with any name and select it in Google's folder picker. Minbox requests permission for selected and app-created files, using Google's drive.file scope. It does not request permission to browse or manage your entire Drive or Google Sheets.

Minbox binds to the selected folder's ID, so renaming it keeps the connection working. It verifies that managed subfolders and archive documents remain inside that selected root and belong to the signed-in owner. Google's permission is per file rather than a recursive folder sandbox; pre-existing archive items can require separate selection during migration. Unrelated folder contents are not imported or managed.

Existing installations with broad Drive or retired Sheets grants require an explicit permission migration and fresh consent. Minbox uses its access to maintain private archive folders and Docs, read designated corrections, and verify outputs. It does not ask you to make your archive public.

AI services and other providers

Full-archive publication uses local filtering and does not require an AI model. Optional work analysis sends selected eligible message/transcript content to the configured AI provider. Connecting Drive to your preferred AI service grants that service access according to the permissions you approve and its own policies.

Google stores your Drive files. Loom handles requests for linked transcripts. Provider retention and model-training settings depend on the provider and account; Minbox does not promise that all third-party processing stays on your device.

Filtering, retention and removal

Authentication codes, clear unsolicited promotional spam and active explicit spam exclusions are excluded from published archive views and AI input. Original local imports may retain excluded records; filtering is not deletion from the local source archive.

Local archive history and revisions remain until explicitly removed. Stopping or uninstalling background jobs preserves data and credentials. To stop Google access, revoke the connected application in your Google Account’s third-party connections (currently branded minbox-text-archive). Delete unwanted Drive files separately and arrange local archive/credential removal with the installation administrator. Copies retained by an AI service must be managed with that service.

Health notifications

Normal operation and ordinary recovery stay local. Optional external email is reserved for unresolved emergencies that require human action. Notices use fixed operational wording, configured owner names and recovery counts; message bodies, contacts, source identifiers, credentials and provider error text are excluded. No routine, reminder or recovery mail is sent.

This information website

These static pages do not request messages, Google sign-in or uploads. They contain no analytics scripts or cookies. Once hosted, the hosting provider may keep normal request logs under its own policies.

Contact

For questions or help removing installation data, email spencer.r.h@gmail.com. Minbox does not sell message content or use it for advertising.
